subject: Life Skills
title: Fire Safety Essentials
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Fire Safety Essentials.

hook.text: You have about three minutes to escape a house fire before conditions become lethal.

buildup.text: Modern furniture burns faster than older materials. Synthetic fabrics and foam can flashover a room in under two.

discovery.text: Smoke alarms cut fire death risk in half. Working ones — test monthly, replace batteries yearly.

twist.text: Most fire deaths happen at night from smoke inhalation, not flames. You will not wake up from the smell alone.

climax.text: Have a meeting spot outside. Practice your escape route once a year. The plan you rehearse is the plan that works.

punchline.text: Smoke alarms save lives. But only working ones.

quiz.question: How often should smoke alarm batteries be replaced?
